versions.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Video Downloader.

- Instantly generates watermark-free download URLs for YouTube videos and shorts in multiple formats and resolutions.
- Supports pasting a single YouTube video or shorts link; batch processing not supported.
- Returns full download links for each video/audio resource, including type, duration, and cover image.
- Requires a valid redfox.hk API key and provides several configuration methods.
- Download links are displayed in full with no truncation for reliability.
